title: Dental PPO Plans Missing-Tooth Clause
content:
**Clause.** When a plan of the Dental PPO Plans has missing-tooth clause months above 0, a bridge, denture or implant that replaces a tooth whose extraction date is before the coverage effective date is not payable until the enrollment has been continuously active for that many calendar months; the line is denied with the missing-tooth remark (on an estimate, the estimate carries the missing-tooth remark).

**Replacements decided on their other rules.** A replacement of a tooth extracted on or after the coverage effective date, or of a tooth extracted before it once the clause period has run, is decided on its other rules.

**Where the clause does not apply.** *Former clause, no longer in force as written:* "The clause does not apply to group enrollments entered at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment, and it does not apply when the person shows prior coverage months that cover the extraction date." Current wording: for a line reprocessed under the Dental PPO correction rule for waiting-period denials counted from the coverage effective date, and for a pre-treatment estimate requested under the estimate-request rule, earlier coverage counts toward the clause as those rules state; every other case remains under this wording: the clause does not apply to group enrollments entered at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment, or when the person shows prior coverage months that cover the extraction date.

### Cases (hypothetical, 12-month clause, outside those two rules)
| Extraction | Enrollment | Months continuously active on the date of service | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before the coverage effective date | Individual, no prior coverage | 11 | Denied with the missing-tooth remark |
| Before the coverage effective date | Individual, no prior coverage | 12 | Decided on its other rules |
| After the coverage effective date | Any | Any | Decided on its other rules |
| Before the coverage effective date | Group, entered at open enrollment | Any | Clause does not apply |

superseded_clauses: The clause does not apply to group enrollments entered at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment, and it does not apply when the person shows prior_coverage_months that cover the extraction date.
